approach: Insert all even numbers into a hash set and scan from 0 upward in steps of 2.
observation: Only even values matter; odd values can be ignored.
bruteForce: Sort and then linearly verify missing even values. O(n log n).
optimalSolution: Hash set of even values plus monotonic scan from 0 by 2 until a gap appears.
dryRun: arr=[0,2,6,4]. set={0,2,4,6}. check 0,2,4,6 all present; next is 8.
